# zendesk-provider-kog — LLM doc index
# A Krateo KOG provider (oasgen-provider >= 0.46.0) exposing the Zendesk Support API's ticketing surface
# as four zendesk.krateo.io kinds: Ticket, Group, Organization, TicketField. The chart ships
# RestDefinitions + trimmed OpenAPI documents and nothing else; oasgen-provider generates the CRDs and a
# rest-dynamic-controller per kind. Bodies are declared UNWRAPPED in the assets; each RestDefinition
# wraps requests ({ticket: .}) and unwraps responses (.ticket). compareScope is updatable everywhere and
# update bodies are deliberately narrow; everything else is create-only. One install = one Zendesk
# account (zendeskSubdomain), because the controller does not substitute OpenAPI server variables.
# oasgen-provider >= 0.46.0 is required: older versions latch a create Zendesk refuses to Available with
# no status.id (oasgen-provider#347).
README.md: what it is, the kind table, install (oasgen-provider >= 0.46.0 and why), configure (values + OAuth bearer token kept fresh by ESO), examples, docs, release
docs/index.md: the map — the four kinds, the facts that hold across them, links to the bundle
docs/overview.md: how it works — RestDefinitions -> CRDs + controllers, the envelope transforms, drift scope, deletion semantics, the server URL
docs/usage.md: install, credentials, apply order, verify
docs/configuration.md: requirements, values, per-kind mappings, compared / create-only / excluded tables, OAS deviations, invariants
docs/api.md: the generated CRDs (spec/status per kind), the Configuration kinds, the CompositionDefinition
docs/examples.md: index of the runnable examples
docs/release.md: one plain-semver tag drives release-oci; the chart is the only artifact
docs/log.md: curated history
chart/Chart.yaml: chart metadata (version stamped from the tag)
chart/values.yaml: resourceGroup + zendeskSubdomain (required)
chart/values.schema.json: the component CRD source
chart/templates/_helpers.tpl: zendesk.asset — resolves the server URL, fails the render on a missing/invalid subdomain
chart/assets/ticket.yaml: Ticket OAS (create/show/update/delete), field-by-field decisions
chart/assets/group.yaml: Group OAS
chart/assets/organization.yaml: Organization OAS
chart/assets/ticketfield.yaml: TicketField OAS
chart/templates/rd-ticket.yaml: Ticket RestDefinition
chart/templates/rd-group.yaml: Group RestDefinition (tombstone notFoundBody)
chart/templates/rd-organization.yaml: Organization RestDefinition
chart/templates/rd-ticketfield.yaml: TicketField RestDefinition
chart/samples/configurations.yaml: the four <Kind>Configuration CRs (basic auth from a Secret)
chart/samples/test-ticket.yaml: sample Ticket
chart/samples/test-group.yaml: sample Group
chart/samples/test-organization.yaml: sample Organization
chart/samples/test-ticketfield.yaml: sample category TicketField
hack/assert-drift-invariants.py: CI guard for every create-only absence, the envelope transforms and compareScope
hack/preflight-refs.py: resolves chart/image references against their registries
examples/ticketing-setup/README.md: the end-to-end walkthrough
